Grammar How it works
The Imperative
ICON_WARDEN
Stop!

We use the imperative to tell people what to do and what not to do.

1
Do: start with the verb
Verb + …
Look both ways.Wear a helmet.
2
Don't: put Don't before the verb
Don't + Verb + …
Don't run.Don't push.
3
No you, no to
✗ You look both ways!✗ Don't to run!✓ Look both ways!✓ Don't run!
4
Always and Never go first
Always wear a seat belt.Never play on the road.
5
Be polite: add Please
Please sit down.Please don't shout.

EXIT TICKETBefore you go: say one Do and one Don't for the street.

Homework

Write 5 safety rules for a little brother or sister: how to get to school safely.

  • Use Do and Don't.
  • Use 5 words from the lesson.
  • Add Always or Never at least once.
  • Draw a picture for each rule.

Worksheet with frames for pictures: PDF for the teacher, page 5.

Extra How it works
How do you get to school?
by
by + transport, no a or the
by busby carby bikeby trainby plane
I go to school by bus.
on foot
We walk: on foot
✗ by foot✓ on foot
I walk to school. I go on foot.
on
Big transport, we can stand or walk inside
on the buson the trainon a plane
Now I'm on the bus.
in
Small transport, we only sit inside
in the carin a taxi
Mum is in the car.
by ↔ in
How we travel ↔ where we are now
I go to work by car. Now I'm in the car.
